blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Abbotsford East. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Abbotsford East, Abbotsford: 69 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 4 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 6%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 3 of 9 Abbotsford communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Abbotsford total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Abbotsford East fell from 71 in June to 69 in September (−2.8%), and 44 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 12.1% of Abbotsford’s 572 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Abbotsford East?
Abbotsford East also had 165 houses listed and 15 sold in September, against 69 condos and townhomes listed. The Abbotsford East houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Abbotsford East?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 69 condos and townhomes listed in Abbotsford East. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Abbotsford East a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Abbotsford East had a sales ratio of 6%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Abbotsford East from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 44 condos and townhomes sold in Abbotsford East over those 4 months, out of 318 in all of Abbotsford.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
